requirementSections.heading: Prescribed Courses
requirementSections.rawText:
Prescribed Courses: Require a grade of C or better
CRIMJ/CRIM 100Introduction to Criminal Justice 3
CRIMJ 210Policing in America3
CRIMJ 220Courts and the Prosecution Process3
CRIMJ 230Corrections in America3
CRIMJ 290Introduction to Internship Experience2
CRIMJ/CRIM 441The Juvenile Justice System3
CRIMJ 450WSenior Seminar3
CRIMJ 495Internship in Criminal Justice3

requirementSections.heading: Additional Courses

rules.commentRaw: Select 9 credits from any 400-level CRIMJ course that does not already fulfill another requirement in the major

requirementSections.rawText:

CRIMJ 250WResearch Methods in Criminal Justice3

requirementSections.heading: Supporting Courses and Related Areas

rules.commentRaw: Select 12 credits, in consultation with the adviser, in one or two of the following skill enhancement areas: accounting, computers, composition and rhetoric, counseling, education, law and legal studies, world language, management, public speaking, research methods and statistics, science and engineering, biobehavioral health; or in the following topics: adolescence, deviant behavior, drugs, minorities
